questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with the solved board configuration, describe the complete path of the first blue ball.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto ramp_right at (3, 0), then ramp_left at (4, 1), then crossover at (3, 2), then ramp_left at (2, 3), then crossover at (1, 4), then ramp_right at (0, 5), then ramp_right at (1, 6), then crossover at (2, 7), then crossover at (3, 8), then ramp_left at (4, 9), and is caught at the left exit.

questions.question: How many blue balls reach the exit?
questions.answer: 8 balls reach an exit in the order: blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left. 8 exit left, 0 exit right, 0 are intercepted.

questions.question: How many ramps were used in the solution?
questions.answer: There are 6 (3 ramp_right, 3 ramp_left) placed by the solution.
